name: Reverse Plank with Leg Lift
steps: Sit with your legs straight and place your palms behind your hips.
Press through your palms and heels to raise your hips into a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
Lift one straight leg smoothly upward off the floor to a comfortable height while pressing hard through your opposite heel.
Lower that heel slowly back down, then raise the opposite leg, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your chest open and shoulders pressed down away from your ears throughout the movement.
Lift your leg only as high as you can while keeping your hips completely elevated and level.
